title: lissera germanica
intro: Lissera germanica, commonly known as German Valerian, is a perennial flowering plant native to Europe, used extensively in herbal medicine for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lissera germanica include acting as a sedative, anti-anxiety agent, and muscle relaxant, which contribute to its use in treating insomnia, restlessness, and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Lissera germanica include valerenic acid, valeranone, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
